ambiguity: PLAY.combat.cover: “Can’t be targeted directly”: does Total Cover stop area effects?
ruling: 'Directly' limits the refusal to effects that select the creature (attack rolls, chosen spell targets, each target of a multi-target spell). An area spell isn't refused. Whether the area reaches a creature behind Total Cover is decided by GLOSS.area-of-effect (a line is blocked only by Total Cover), so with Total Cover from the origin it isn't affected. SPL-05 stays as is.
